name: Deliverable
hint: What exactly is handed in: format, files, length, parts (report, code, slides, video...).

name: Audience
hint: Who reads, uses or marks the work, and what they already know.

name: Topic and scope
hint: The topic or problem, and what is in and out of scope.

name: Required content
hint: Sections, features or elements that must be included.

name: Constraints from the guideline
hint: Word or page limits, format rules, allowed or banned methods, tools or sources.

name: Evaluation criteria
hint: How the work is marked and which parts carry the most weight.

name: Methods or tools
hint: The approach, methods, languages, frameworks or software to use.

name: Data or resources available
hint: Datasets, materials, existing work, access or equipment the student has.

name: Roles
hint: Group size, who does which part, and how the parts come together.

name: Citation and sources
hint: Citation style, number and kind of sources required (journals, recent years...).

name: Timeline concerns
hint: Milestones, interim submissions, and how much time the student can actually spend.

name: Success definition
hint: What the student is aiming for (pass, high mark, portfolio piece) and what done looks like.
